lines.trans: On tonight's stage, Li Mingji did not see the gemstone.
So the moment he stepped onstage, panic had already started in his heart.
I have already spoken with the emergency doctors.
In the studio I run, I notice even a single extra needle on the stage.
If you doubt me, I have security footage I can pull up for you anytime.
Mr Chun Yuqiao really knows how to make up stories.
You have no proof, and even when Brother Li wakes up he will not admit it.
A celebrated veteran singer unable to finish a show because of stage fright.
What happens if word like that gets out? Bring your lawyers and let us talk.
Withdraw the police report and revise your team's public statement.
